function.description: Get personalized Jupiter Prediction event recommendations for ANY wallet address (not only your own). Use solana.predict.events/.search instead for an unpersonalized browse/keyword lookup.
function.name: solana__predict_suggested_events_list

includeMarkets.description: Include each recommended event's nested markets array (default false — lean).

provider.description: Provider: kalshi, polymarket, or bisonfi (Jupiter Forecast). Default polymarket.

walletAddress.description: The wallet ACCOUNT to base recommendations on, as a Solana address — any wallet, not only your own.
